title: Girl Arrested For Leaving A Used Condom At Neighbor's Door
description:
On January 11th, 2022, officers were dispatched in response to an altercation. The caller reported that her neighbor left used condoms in front of her door and punched her. The suspect also spat on the police when they approached her. The woman refused to admit her actions and continued to verbally abuse the officers. She continued to act agitated and yell at the officers. The woman was charged with aggravated battery upon a peace officer, resisting arrest and obstructing justice.
